title: Informed Machine Learning with Knowledge Landmarks
abstract: arXiv:2604.00256v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Informed Machine Learning (ML) aims to improve prediction by using both data and prior knowledge. In scientific and engineering applications, accurate measurements may occupy only a small operating region of the input space, whereas available knowledge is global, coarse, and not expressed as equations. Existing physics-informed methods embed governing equations, residuals, simulators, operators, or mathematically specified constraints. However, they do not directly address learning from localized numeric data together with non-equational knowledge. We develop a Knowledge-Data (KD) ML framework for this setting. The KD-model represents coarse global knowledge as input-output information granules, termed knowledge landmarks. The method uses a landmark-guided objective that converts these landmarks into differentiable compatibility terms and balances them against local data fitting through a trade-off parameter $\lambda$. translated_title: 基于知识地标的知识驱动机器学习
translated_abstract: 知识驱动机器学习旨在通过同时利用数据和先验知识来改进预测。在科学与工程应用中，精确测量可能仅占据输入空间的一小部分运行区域，而可获得的知识则是全局的、粗粒度的，且并不以方程形式表达。现有的物理信息方法嵌入控制方程、残差、模拟器、算子或数学上明确规定的约束，然而它们并未直接解决从局部化数值数据与非方程性知识中共同学习的问题。针对这一情形，我们提出了一个知识-数据（KD）机器学习框架。该KD模型将粗粒度的全局知识表示为输入-输出信息粒，称为知识地标。该方法使用地标引导的目标函数，将这些地标转换为可微的相容性项，并通过权衡参数 λ 将其与局部数据拟合进行平衡。实验在（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出知识-数据（KD）机器学习框架，将粗粒度的全局知识表示为可微的“知识地标”相容性项，并通过权衡参数与局部数据拟合相平衡，从而在数据稀疏且知识无法用方程表达的场景下提升预测性能。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a Knowledge-Data (KD) machine learning framework that represents coarse, non-equational global knowledge as "knowledge landmarks" — differentiable compatibility terms balanced against local data fitting via a trade-off parameter — enabling prediction when accurate data covers only a small operating region.
